sources.excerpt: Fatpipe Guitar Effects Pedal WELCOME TO OUR COMPANY Guitar Effects Boxes: We manufacture innovative, sophisticated Effects Boxes for guitar, Fatpipe Pro and Fatpipe Blues, at a price point that is accessible to most musicians. These Effects boxes are high tech in design and manufacture, using surface mount technology, built with high quality components, all mounted in rugged solid cast aluminum chassis. They are built tough for the professional musician, but are affordable for aspiring newcomers The Fatpipe series of Distortion Pedals are the high tech solution for Professional sounding guitar distortion effects. They feature advanced electronic design using sophisticated miniature surface mount components, enabling unlimited but precise control of guitar timbre (over 80 electrical components in the Fatpipe Pro and Blues Pedals - the Guts! ). These pedals are designed for serious musicians who care about every sonic detail. Our Premium pedal is the Fatpipe Pro , featuring 3 band EQ, Gain and Level Controls for the Distortion, plus a separate amplitude Boost control. We offer a tamer version called the Fatpipe Blues with less distortion and more subtle control. Models are fully " Tru-bypass " switching. For additional information, click on engineering remarks or features or view a copy of the User Manual .
